closeout_operational.failed: A combined status, head, branch, line-count, and source-tail probe exceeded its bound before yielding attributable output and earned zero review credit.
closeout_operational.recovery: Audit repository status first, then split scalar Git and bounded file reads into separate commands.
closeout_operational.recurrence_guard: Do not combine cold Git state probes with source-file reads in one closeout command.

closeout_operational.failed: A manifest count probe successfully read the evidence manifest but then assumed a nonexistent x1-final-manifest filename and earned no x1-manifest review credit.
closeout_operational.recovery: Inventory the exact phase validation filenames before selecting the committed x1 staged manifest.
closeout_operational.recurrence_guard: Resolve manifest filenames from the phase directory before projecting their schemas or counts.

closeout_operational.failed: A proposal-title probe assumed an x1 proposal-ledger path that does not exist and therefore produced no proposal-review evidence.
closeout_operational.recovery: Inventory the exact owner packet paths and read the committed proposal ledger from its actual directory.
closeout_operational.recurrence_guard: Resolve phase artifact paths before projecting their fields.

closeout_operational.failed: A runner-plan probe assumed a preregistration filename that is not present and therefore earned no runner-inventory credit.
closeout_operational.recovery: Use the committed phase-data runner declarations and exact tooling inventory files discovered from the owner packet.
closeout_operational.recurrence_guard: Inventory exact runner artifacts before reading them.

closeout_operational.failed: The first closeout build reconstructed and validated Method Flow but stopped before seal output because its operational-parity assertion omitted five inherited external witness pairs.
closeout_operational.recovery: Include the five inherited external negative records with x1, x2, and closeout failures in the parity domain, then rebuild from immutable evidence.
closeout_operational.recurrence_guard: Define Method Flow parity over every inherited-external and owner-phase failure represented by the ledger.

closeout_operational.failed: The first staged current-phase aggregate passed 25 of 26 tests but failed a case-sensitive assertion that expected a lower-case baton heading phrase while the committed heading correctly begins with an upper-case word.
closeout_operational.recovery: Bind the structural test to the exact heading capitalization without changing the sanitized baton meaning.
closeout_operational.recurrence_guard: Use exact normalized headings for case-sensitive document assertions.

recovery_boundary: A bounded passing recovery never erases its failed witness or gains independent, empirical, professional, production, legal, cultural, privacy-complete, accessibility-complete, or Stage 20 credit.

x1_operational.failed: A PowerShell foreach statement was piped directly during skill discovery and failed before execution.
x1_operational.recovery: Materialize foreach output before piping.
x1_operational.recurrence_guard: Never pipe directly from a PowerShell foreach statement.

x1_operational.failed: The first Method Flow schema read assumed a nonexistent method-flow-state-schema filename.
x1_operational.recovery: Read the exact references/schema.md path named by the skill.
x1_operational.recurrence_guard: Resolve every skill-relative reference from the complete SKILL.md before use.

x1_operational.failed: A combined worktree inventory and receipt search exceeded its bound without complete attributable output.
x1_operational.recovery: Split worktree discovery from exact receipt probes.
x1_operational.recurrence_guard: Use one cold filesystem subsystem per bounded discovery command.

x1_operational.failed: A narrowed multi-root receipt search still timed out before a complete result.
x1_operational.recovery: Probe the exact expected receipt path and digest directly.
x1_operational.recurrence_guard: Prefer exact candidate paths over recursive multi-root scans.

x1_operational.failed: A combined source branch, history, clean-state, remote, and digest verification timed out before a complete result.
x1_operational.recovery: Split immutable refs, ancestry, live remote, clean state, and digest into scalar probes.
x1_operational.recurrence_guard: Keep local Git checks separate from fresh-live and filesystem hashing.

x1_operational.failed: The first external receipt projection used property names not present in the committed schema.
x1_operational.recovery: Inspect receipt keys before binding exact fields.
x1_operational.recurrence_guard: Discover JSON schema keys before projecting evidence.

x1_operational.failed: Windows PowerShell 5.1 rejected the unsupported ConvertFrom-Json Depth parameter.
x1_operational.recovery: Omit the unsupported parameter and parse the bounded document with the installed command surface.
x1_operational.recurrence_guard: Preflight shell-version-specific parameters.

x1_operational.failed: A small artifact-group read piped directly from foreach and failed before execution.
x1_operational.recovery: Materialize the artifact group before piping.
x1_operational.recurrence_guard: Never pipe directly from a PowerShell foreach statement.

x1_operational.failed: The first compact Method Flow projection used property names not present in the committed schema.
x1_operational.recovery: Inspect a real method and witness before binding names.
x1_operational.recurrence_guard: Bind Method Flow keys only after schema and instance discovery.

x1_operational.failed: A compact Method Flow foreach projection was piped directly and failed before execution.
x1_operational.recovery: Materialize projection output before formatting.
x1_operational.recurrence_guard: Never pipe directly from a PowerShell foreach statement.

x1_operational.failed: The first frozen-chain parser assumed a proposals array instead of prior_proposals plus new_proposals.
x1_operational.recovery: Inspect top-level keys and concatenate the two committed arrays.
x1_operational.recurrence_guard: Discover proposal-chain schema before counting or hashing.

x1_operational.failed: Node execFileSync exhausted its default buffer while reading the source tree and produced no manifest credit.
x1_operational.recovery: Retry the unchanged read-only command with an explicit bounded 128 MB buffer.
x1_operational.recurrence_guard: Set a justified output buffer before large Git tree reads.

x1_operational.failed: A combined immediate and long-range route-audit read timed out before complete output.
x1_operational.recovery: Read each route artifact in its own bounded scalar probe.
x1_operational.recurrence_guard: Do not aggregate independent route artifacts in one cold read.

x1_operational.failed: A formatted full-route JSON wrapper timed out and earned no audit credit.
x1_operational.recovery: Read the raw scalar audit fields separately.
x1_operational.recurrence_guard: Prefer bounded scalar extraction over whole-object formatting for large route records.

x1_operational.failed: A branch and path preflight embedded child exit-code expressions inside a PowerShell hash literal and failed before execution.
x1_operational.recovery: Compute scalar exit codes before constructing the record.
x1_operational.recurrence_guard: Never embed child-process statements inside PowerShell literal expressions.

x1_operational.failed: The owned worktree-add wrapper timed out after Git had completed the additive checkout.
x1_operational.recovery: Audit exact path, registration, branch, head, clean state, processes, and locks before deciding whether to retry.
x1_operational.recurrence_guard: Never retry a timed-out mutating Git command before a complete state audit.

x1_operational.failed: The first registration counter compared a backslash path with Git's forward-slash worktree output and falsely reported zero.
x1_operational.recovery: Normalize separators and inspect the exact registration record.
x1_operational.recurrence_guard: Normalize path separators before comparing Git administrative output.

x1_operational.failed: The first novelty search piped directly from foreach and failed before execution.
x1_operational.recovery: Materialize the search output before sorting or formatting.
x1_operational.recurrence_guard: Never pipe directly from a PowerShell foreach statement.

x1_operational.failed: A candidate novelty query omitted required whitespace in a foreach statement and failed before execution.
x1_operational.recovery: Correct the syntax and rerun the unchanged read-only calculation.
x1_operational.recurrence_guard: Use formatted multi-line PowerShell for nontrivial loops.

x1_operational.failed: A keyword search omitted required whitespace in a foreach statement and failed before execution.
x1_operational.recovery: Correct the syntax and rerun the unchanged read-only search.
x1_operational.recurrence_guard: Use formatted multi-line PowerShell for nontrivial loops.

x1_operational.failed: A combined status, full untracked-file diff, and Select-String inspection timed out before attributable output.
x1_operational.recovery: Split clean-state and bounded source-range inspections into separate probes.
x1_operational.recurrence_guard: Never combine potentially large untracked-file inspection with Git status.

x1_operational.failed: A combined accessible-report and x1-test patch failed because one Unicode context line did not match exactly.
x1_operational.recovery: Split the change into smaller exact-context patches and retain the failed attempt.
x1_operational.recurrence_guard: Do not combine Unicode-sensitive and independent source edits in one patch.

x1_operational.failed: The first x1 build pointed to Tamar v654-v1's 1,690-row index and stopped before generating the packet because the activation baseline requires 1,720.
x1_operational.recovery: Bind the exact committed Elowen v654-v2 frozen-chain index and rerun from the unchanged x1 data.
x1_operational.recurrence_guard: Resolve the immediate source-owner proposal index before building a successor freeze.

x1_operational.failed: A recursive frozen-index inventory over the inherited docs tree timed out without a complete result.
x1_operational.recovery: Probe the exact expected Elowen phase path and verify its 1,690 plus 30 equals 1,720 counts.
x1_operational.recurrence_guard: Prefer exact phase-local artifact paths over recursive repository inventories.

x1_operational.failed: The first workflow-plan request was rejected because the current runner hard-codes an existing-task route while Hamish's live terminal authority requires one new user-visible main task.
x1_operational.recovery: Retain the failed audit, supply the validator's compatibility literal only for its structural check, and record the exact live new-task authority in separate controlling fields.
x1_operational.recurrence_guard: Never let a compatibility literal override newer exact live route authority or trigger a premature task action.

x1_operational.failed: The first post-push divergence wrapper let PowerShell reinterpret the unquoted upstream shorthand, so Git received an invalid revision and the comparison earned zero credit.
x1_operational.recovery: Quote HEAD...@{u} as a literal Git argument; the recovery proved zero ahead and zero behind.
x1_operational.recurrence_guard: Quote every Git upstream shorthand passed through PowerShell.

x2_operational.failed: The first broad x2 evidence patch matched the structural sections but failed atomically on one Unicode-sensitive boundary line, so it changed no file and earned zero credit.
x2_operational.recovery: Split runner, skill, test, and truth edits into smaller exact-context patches.
x2_operational.recurrence_guard: Do not combine Unicode-sensitive prose with independent structural edits in one patch.

x2_operational.failed: A compound stale-label search crossed the PowerShell quoting boundary before ripgrep executed and earned zero review credit.
x2_operational.recovery: Use a single-quoted bounded pattern without shell-sensitive Unicode fragments.
x2_operational.recurrence_guard: Keep Windows stale-label review patterns simple and shell-literal.

x2_operational.failed: A stale-label review passed a wildcard as a literal Windows path to ripgrep and failed before scanning any file.
x2_operational.recovery: Search the literal scripts directory with an explicit file glob.
x2_operational.recurrence_guard: Never pass an unresolved Windows wildcard path as a ripgrep path operand.

x2_operational.failed: The first current-phase aggregate passed 15 tests but failed one x1 lifecycle assertion because the x1 test read the live 34-method ledger instead of the immutable 31-method x1 ledger.
x2_operational.recovery: Read the Method Flow ledger from the frozen x1 commit for x1-specific assertions, while leaving x2 evidence tests on the live ledger.
x2_operational.recurrence_guard: Every lifecycle-specific test must bind immutable phase artifacts rather than mutable successor files.

x2_operational.failed: The second current-phase aggregate found the initial x1 freeze commit by message and read 30 methods instead of the repaired final x1 commit's 31 methods.
x2_operational.recovery: Bind the already verified exact final x1 anchor directly in the lifecycle test.
x2_operational.recurrence_guard: Use exact lifecycle anchors when a phase contains more than one x1 commit.
